connector.name: VenuNite Events
connector.registryDescription: Hyperlocal event search across 50 US states - 29K venues, 275K upcoming events.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.venunite.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package venunite-events. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the isaacaskew account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VENUNITE_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token from the VenuNite account portal. Required.
